TABLE.NAME: block_elediaaitutor_conv
TABLE.COMMENT: Local conversation metadata for the eLeDia.ai Tutor. Full chat history is owned by the external RAG/Tutor server; this table only tracks the lightweight pointer (the server-issued conversation id) plus display metadata so a user can resume and list their own conversations. No full message content is stored here.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Owner of the conversation (the Moodle user).

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course context the conversation was started in, or null/0 for global chat.

FIELD.NAME: conversationid
FIELD.COMMENT: Opaque conversation identifier issued by the external RAG/Tutor server.

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional display title for the conversation.

FIELD.NAME: lastpreview
FIELD.COMMENT: Short preview of the last message, for the conversation list. Truncated; not a full transcript.

INDEX.NAME: userid-conversationid
INDEX.COMMENT: Resolve a server conversation id within an owner, and guard against duplicates.

TABLE.NAME: block_elediaaitutor_qlog
TABLE.COMMENT: Opt-in question analytics: learner questions (never answers) logged per course so teachers can spot confusion hotspots. Collection is disabled by default; rows are pruned by a scheduled task after the configured retention and are covered by the privacy provider.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The asker. Stored so privacy export/erasure works; never displayed in reports.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course the question was asked in, or 0 for global chat.

FIELD.NAME: grounded
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the answer cited course materials.

FIELD.NAME: topic
FIELD.COMMENT: Canonical topic label supplied by the RAG server, used to cluster questions in the teacher report.

FIELD.NAME: sourcetitle
FIELD.COMMENT: Title of the primary cited source (sources[0]); hotspot fallback when no topic was supplied.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module id resolved from the primary source URL, when it points at this site.
